claim: Overlay hooks need a test that replays the build's overlay code along the whole recording, because the cursor moves and the interrupt-driven printer writes between redraws.

evidence.text: After hardware runs 1-2, m3b_seq replays the build's overlay code along the recording (5,357 views, 3,670 cursor moves, 87 portcullis steps); the printer writes the view buffer between views without reaching the screen.
